context_before: e beginning God created the heavens and the earth,” and John tells us: “In the beginning was the Word and the Word was with God and the Word was God.”

quote_original: If you have tried and tried to imagine, yet failed, don’t give up, try to be more intense.
context_before: I urge you not to despair.
context_after: Try to be more believing concerning the reality of your imaginal act. Man, believing in the mechanism of the universe, finds it difficult to see it as imaginal, but it is. But the change takes place in the imagination, not in the world!
